convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iStochastic indicator. Simple crossover entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Standard position sizing.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative Lots input = fixed lot size (absolute value); positive Lots input = fraction of free margin

custom_logic_notes: Duplex means two Stochastic oscillators are used. The first Stochastic's %K/%D crossover provides the primary signal direction, and the second Stochastic's %K line relative to the first acts as a confirmation filter. Long requires Stoch1 %K crosses above Stoch1 %D AND Stoch1 %K > Stoch2 %K. Short requires Stoch1 %K crosses below Stoch1 %D AND Stoch1 %K < Stoch2 %K. SL/TP pip values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001. Previous bar values [1] are used for crossover detection (current [0] vs previous [1] comparison).
python_conversion_notes: Use ta-library or pandas-ta stochastic oscillator. Two instances with same default params (k=14, d=3, slowing=3). Crossover detection needs previous-bar vs current-bar comparison on completed bars only (new_bar_guard). Position sizing: if Lots<0 use abs(Lots) as fixed; if Lots>0 use Lots*AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN_FREE)/1000 as margin fraction. Digit adjustment: if point<0.001 multiply SL/TP by 10. Signal reversal: close opposite position before entry.
